findings.text: The new array check passes the context "checked module documentation" without the module name, so a malformed inventory gives "Invalid array in checked module documentation" and doesn't say which module failed. Fix: put the module name in the `sequence` context, for example `f"{name}: checked module documentation"`.

The new array check passes the context "declaration documentation" without the module or declaration, so the error doesn't say where the malformed documentation ranges are. Fix: use `f"{name}: {constant_name} documentation"` as the `sequence` context, as the `position` call on the same line already does.
